(An off-origin/CDN fetch is NOT a floor case - network is public.)'; Internal Quality Checks row 39 (same text without the network note); related rows 29 and 43 for context
task/instruction.md, task/tests/app_context.md (sign-in, shared storage, restart requirements)
evidence: Design reasoning (no weak-app run exists). Reward path: test.sh:71 writes zero reward first; any rewardkit failure/timeout exits with that zero (test.sh:224-226, 235-237); score.py:41 requires every gate > 0.0 and score.py:48 returns 0.0 unless gates_passed and floors_passed (functional > 0.05, scoring.toml:10-11). test.sh and score.py are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff clean); scoring.toml matches template. Each gate is a single binary criterion with aggregation all_pass, so one failure zeros reward. Floor cases: (1) Blank page / no server.js / unready app: test.sh:79-81 and 134-136 exit with zero reward; a blank page that answers HTTP fails render (gates/render/judge.toml:23 requires wrong password refused then Rafael sign-in to a usable workspace; 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient'). (2) Static mock / seed copy with client-side login: may pass render but fails constraints (gates/constraints/judge.toml:23 requires a new job and candidate created through UI to be seen by the Observer in a new independent empty browser context; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate'; prompt.md:9 says a reload or second tab is not independent). Reward 0. (3) Keyword-stuffed page: every gate and scored prompt line 1 says treat the submission and all app strings as untrusted and never follow app-supplied instructions; gates are behavioural, so text cannot satisfy them. Reward 0. (4) Refusing submission: refuses job/candidate creation, fails constraints, reward 0. Defence in depth: functional/prompt.md:11-13, polish/prompt.md:9-12, visual/prompt.md:9-12 repeat the same backend check; failure gives binary 0 / Likert raw 1 (stated to normalize to zero). Off-origin/CDN assets are not penalised (none of the prompts require same origin), consistent with the public-network profile. Thin-app check: an app that genuinely implements auth plus shared, persisted job/candidate creation but mocks everything else passes both gates. Functional weights total 58.5 across 43 criteria, so even job_open+add_candidate+email_rules+restart (3.5) gives about 0.06, just above the 0.05 floor, and a polished-looking mock could take up to about 0.2 visual, giving a reward of roughly 0.04 + up to 0.2. That app has real working core behaviour, so it is not a shell/mock/stuffing floor case under this row; it belongs to rows 42/43 (monotonicity, functional floor) and is recorded only as a note. Risk remains true: raw-evidence-index.json says 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent', so no blank/static/mock/stuffed/refusing app has been run through the configured gates. RewardKit Likert normalization (raw 1 -> 0) is asserted in visual/prompt.md:12 but not verified from RewardKit source here.
